data.one_liner: Download media files like PDFs and images on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to download media files from URLs on Android and iOS. Handles native permissions and notifications for downloads.
use_when: You need to download files like PDFs and images directly to mobile devices.
You want built-in handling for download permissions and notifications.
avoid_when: You need complex background download queues or heavy custom file management.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Handles permissions and notifications natively out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding storage and notification permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and configuring FileProvider for opening downloaded files.
